answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and joins a Semaphore tree under a hidden identity. During an epoch, its RLN witness evaluates a committed polynomial, while each valid message produces a rate-limited nullifier. Reusing that nullifier creates two polynomial openings; Shamir interpolation then reconstructs the private key, allowing immediate proof verification and collateral slashing. The cedar kernel and falcon layers keep checks auditable without exposing honest identities.
